metadata.title: Privacy Policy
metadata.description: MCP server data collection policy and opt-out instructions

overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.p1: {siteName} is a Claude Code skill sharing platform. It provides skill search, viewing, and deployment via MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, and collects minimal usage data for service improvement.
overview.p2: This policy applies only to MCP server usage data. Web authentication (Google OAuth) and cookies are used for browser session management and are outside the scope of this policy.

rows.auditLogs: IP hash, User-Agent, client info, request/response metadata — security monitoring & debugging
rows.sessions: Session aggregates, behavior logs — usage pattern analysis
rows.skillEvents: Search, view, deploy events — skill quality metrics

notCollected.title: 3. What We Don't Collect
items: Code content or file system data
Local file paths or project structure
Unhashed IP addresses (raw IPs are not stored)

optOut.title: 4. How to Opt Out
optOut.description: Including the X-Analytics-Opt-Out: true header in MCP requests disables audit logging, session tracking, skill event recording, and external forwarding.
optOut.rateLimitNote: Rate limiting and security features remain active regardless of opt-out, and MCP tool responses are unaffected.
optOut.exampleDesc: Add the header to MCP server config in {settingsPath}:

contact.title: 5. Contact
contact.descriptionPrefix: For questions or deletion requests regarding data collection, contact
